Right, my audio profile. I am Ana and I am thirteen. On weekdays my routine is always the same: school, lunch, homework, and then I am free. I usually swim on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and once in a while I go to the pool on Saturday too, but only if my sister goes. I am quite good at swimming, actually. I hardly ever watch television, because I can't stand the commercials, so I read instead. And I never do my homework at night. Never. I always do it before dinner, or it does not get done.

A quick note about the noticeboard, because people keep asking. The board is always up to date, and I update it every Monday morning. New members join on the first Wednesday of the month, so if somebody new appears in your group, that is why. We rarely change the meeting time, but it does happen twice a year, in December and in July. And one thing that surprises people: we hardly ever cancel. In four years we have cancelled twice. So if the weather is bad, come anyway.
